name: Jacquard
desc: A weaving draft that is actually being woven — threading diagram over the warp, tie-up square, treadling column, and a drawdown where the cloth grows pick by pick at the fell as a shuttle flies across, warp and weft floats catching the light in colour-and-weave stripes, and every section the loom is re-drafted so the pattern changes above the fell line.

energy.doc: weaving rate + thread relief + shuttle glow + draft drift

scale.doc: the sett — thread coarseness. Coarse cloth at 2.4, a fine dense web at 0.35; the draft always fills the sheet

speed.doc: picks per second at the fell

hue.doc: warp hue (cloth/ghost styles); weft sits opposite it

sett.doc: shafts lifted per treadle — 0 is a weft-faced 1/N twill, 1 a warp-faced N/1

anno.doc: annotation density: diagram boxes, shaft/treadle numbering, labels, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: woven thread rendering / draft (pure black-and-white notation squares, the abstraction) / prussian cyanotype / indigo-and-ecru textile / additive glowing ghost threads

seed.doc: draft modes, block sequences, warp and weft stripe order
